upal.ieee802154.title: IEEE 802.15.4 MAC/radio frame provider
upal.ieee802154.reason: Fixed-frame dispatch exists; PHY/channel profile, frame security, radio timing, and exact target evidence remain provider-owned.

uproto.canopen_fd.title: CANopen FD (CiA 1301) bounded USDO/PDO adapter
uproto.canopen_fd.reason: Typed declarations and fail-closed definitions exist; standard FD wire behavior, USDO sessions, provider binding, XDD and conformance evidence remain unimplemented.

uproto.medi_can.title: Myovena MEDI CAN protocol extending CANopen FD
uproto.medi_can.reason: Independent typed protocol scaffold with fail-closed operations. MEDI wire binding, no-silent-loss delivery, bounded ACK/retry/deadline rules, integrity/freshness, replay/deduplication, durable recovery and trusted execution remain unimplemented; no medical safety guarantee is established.
depends_on: selected MEDI integrity, journal and execution providers
